proof_body:
by
  intro K _ hK x y
  have h2 : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := by
    have := hK 1
    intro h
    apply this
    rw [one_pow]
    linear_combination h
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, hy⟩
    have hy1 : 1 + y ≠ 0 := fun e => hy (by linear_combination e)
    have ht := hK (x / (1 + y))
    have e : 1 + (x / (1 + y)) ^ 2 = 2 / (1 + y) := by
      rw [div_pow, eq_div_iff hy1, add_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_comm, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero 2 hy1)]
      linear_combination -(1 + y) * h
    refine ⟨x / (1 + y), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e]; field_simp
    · have e3 : (x / (1 + y)) ^ 2 = 2 / (1 + y) - 1 := by rw [← e]; ring
      have e2 : 1 - (x / (1 + y)) ^ 2 = 2 * y / (1 + y) := by
        rw [e3]
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [e, e2]
      field_simp
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl, rfl⟩
    have ht := hK t
    constructor
    · field_simp
      ring
    · intro e
      rw [div_eq_iff ht] at e
      apply h2
      linear_combination e
